binding_requirements.operator_role: Existing reviewed IAM role, not an invented role/user/session ARN; verify trust and same intended account
binding_requirements.cidrs: Actual operator egress CIDRs, never 0.0.0.0/0 or inferred workstation LAN IP
binding_requirements.irsa: Substitute verified issuer keys and exact system:serviceaccount:namespace:name per controller; never use namespace wildcards
binding_requirements.cluster_access: API access entry plus explicit EKS ClusterAdminPolicy for reviewed operator; creator admin remains off
binding_requirements.kubernetes_operator_minimum: After access bootstrap, use least privilege for reviewed namespace/CRD/controller installation; no raw Secret logging
binding_requirements.policy_pin: Review the current AWS-managed default policy version/document before attachment, or approve an immutable policy copy. A source ARN is not current policy approval or an immutable pin.
binding_requirements.target_registration_policy: Replace null Resource with actual frontend target group ARN before validation/attachment. Minimal TGB-only candidate requires acceptance with this chart/controller; no CreateLoadBalancer, no SG mutation. Do not silently broaden on AccessDenied.
